title: Countries explore strategic Bitcoin reserve policies
content:
TL;DR: Nation-states are increasingly exploring Bitcoin as a strategic reserve, signaling a profound shift in global monetary policy. With the Bitcoin network operating robustly at block 934,997 and a substantial hashrate of 896.16 EH/s, its immutable security offers an incorruptible alternative to depreciating fiat. Transactors should prepare for potential shifts in network demand and fee markets as sovereign entities recognize Bitcoin's role in securing national wealth against currency debasement.

The Report

As of February 04, 2026, at 14:09 UTC, the global financial landscape is witnessing a quiet but profound transformation: an increasing number of nation-states are actively exploring or discreetly implementing policies to hold Bitcoin as a strategic reserve asset. This development, previously confined to the fringes of economic discussion, is now gaining traction in corridors of power, driven by persistent inflation, geopolitical instability, and a growing distrust in the existing fiat monetary system.

The Bitcoin network itself continues its relentless march, providing the foundational security for this burgeoning interest. We find the network currently at block height 934,997, operating without interruption. The computational power dedicated to securing this decentralized ledger, the hashrate, stands at a formidable 896.16 EH/s. While this figure represents a slight dip from the approximately 977 EH/s observed in late January 2026, and certainly below the November 2025 peak of 1042 EH/s, it nonetheless signifies an immense global commitment to Bitcoin's integrity. This significant hashpower ensures that the network remains incredibly resistant to attack, a critical factor for any sovereign entity considering it as a store of value
